title: Pin network replay high-water LRU eviction (honest signer eviction)
description: python/src/lichen/timing/stratum.py:626-632: the MAX_NETWORK_REPLAY_GENERATIONS LRU cap (popitem(last=False)) can evict an honest signer's high-water entry when an attacker-controlled signer floods 256 key rotations, re-admitting that signer's already-consumed counter. No test pins eviction behavior. Exploitation is expensive (256 live generations plus defeating link replay and freshness policy) but the behavior is unpinned — add a test that documents/guards the eviction semantics.
